messages.author: d2bffd1a5d780ca8
messages.subject: Implied correlation matrix
parts:
Hello, guys.

I think my problem is really simple but I don't know how to solve it. How can I obtain the implied correlation matrix after a CFA? I know that with fitted function or fitted.values function I can get the covariance matrix, but what about the correlation matrix?

Thanks.

messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: Re: Implied correlation matrix
parts:
Hi
I think the solution for your problem is simple. HTH
The fitted() and fitted.values() functions return the model-implied (fitted) covariance matrix 
for more see this page 
https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/inspect.html

messages.author: 6f81c58ba9ed02c3
messages.subject: Re: Implied correlation matrix
parts:
Have you tried lavInspect(fit, what = "cor.ov")?
https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/lavaan/versions/0.6-7/topics/lavInspect
lavInspect function | R Documentation
<p>The <code>lavInspect()</code> and <code>lavTech()</code> functions can be used to inspect/extract information that is stored inside (or can be computed from) a fitted lavaan object. Note: the (older) <code>inspect()</code> function is now simply a shortcut for <code>lavInspect()</code> with default arguments.</p>
www.rdocumentation.org
